snippet.title: Armored Suit Solgante - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Lieutenant Will, an armored suit pilot, works diligently to combat threats to the nation. Unfortunately, in his struggle to fight against terrorists, he’s implicated in one of the very schemes he’s fighting against.
